title: q-enriched-cohomology
description: The Q-enriched cohomology of a Q-enriched sheaf on a Grothendieck site, generated by equipping that sheaf with the standard cochain-complex construction whose kernel, image, and quotient are taken in the Q-Cat sense; degree-0 recovers the Lawvere-Laplacian fixed points.

site.description: the Grothendieck site (T, J) over which the enriched sheaf F is taken

cochainComplex.description: the n-th cochain group C^n F := prod over sigma in T_n of F(sigma), living in Q-Cat_cwl

degree.description: n, the cochain degree; T_n are the n-dimensional cells of the site

value.description: C^n F is an object of Q-Cat_cwl, the product of the sheaf values over n-cells

coboundary.description: delta^n : C^n F -> C^{n+1} F with (delta^n x)(tau) = weighted-meet over faces sigma_i of tau of the right Q-adjoint F(sigma_i -> tau)^*(x(sigma_i))

cohomology.description: H^n_Q := ker(delta^n) / image(delta^{n-1}), the Q-Cat quotient of the largest sub-Q-category on which delta^n vanishes by the smallest one containing image(delta^{n-1})

degreeZeroIsLaplacianFixedPoints.description: H^0_Q = ker(delta^0) is isomorphic to Fix(L), the suffix points of the Lawvere Laplacian (Tarski-Lawvere fixed point theorem)
